$Comment: Oiler: the Heartwinder's support, a brass oil can on three legs with a long spout (DESIGN.md 6.1, 6.2, 7.6). 45 HP (Gibson round 2 note 22), walks at 2.2. It walks to its master and oils it for +120 (phases 1 and 2), then leaves; kill it on the way (analogue vanilla Dungeon_Goblin_Food_Carrier, +85 to the Feastmaster). The spawn marker of the same id makes one in four a Grit Oiler.
